rawContent: State surveillance has a chilling effect on Black activists' freedom to protest, to speak out and to live. On #Juneteenth, we reflect on how far we've come and how far we have to still go to #ProtectBlackDissent and to make #BlackLivesMatter: https://t.co/BT1SoQLjKs https://t.co/D3lkupL46X
State surveillance has a chilling effect on Black activists' freedom to protest, to speak out and to live. Join our movement to #ProtectBlackDissent: https://t.co/BT1SoQLjKs #BlackLivesMatter

“[After] #FreddieGray’s death in 2015, police spied on #BlackLivesMatter protesters w/ face recognition tech. The term ‘#ElectronicMonitoring’ may soon refer not just to a specific piece of equipment but to an all-encompassing strategy." https://t.co/PPAZfwI1Ql #NoDigitalPrisons

Mustafa Jumale of @BAJItweet reflects on why Congress is a good place to #ProtectBlackDissent, and why @mediajustice took a Black delegation there to speak truth to power on the surveillance of Black activists. https://t.co/XS0mBZsGcQ #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/sehNSKIOnl
